generated_evidence.quote_en: **Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish. Approval binds exactly reviewed content. Final-response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically; replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval. Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes; reject stale evidence even after successful search/review. Publication invoker, endpoint/button, exact status mapping and recovery are open.
